profile: Mac Companion local XPC Interactive lease transport v0.1
rules: same-team exact-role authentication and menu readiness are required before Interactive lease traffic
the Agent sender and menu receiver share exactly one cross-family command in flight for Desktop preparation, install, renewal, and revoke per authenticated generation
request and payload-bearing success values are nonempty canonical JSON data no larger than 4096 bytes
Desktop preparation receives the exact session, authorization epoch, opaque selected-display UUID, and canonical interaction classes and returns one exactly correlated Desktop descriptor
install carries the complete current prepared Desktop descriptor and its lease binds the exact session, epoch, surface, revisions, and interaction classes before any platform effect

the menu samples its local monotonic clock, resolves the opaque display only inside the menu process, and returns no physical display identifier, display name, process identifier, window identifier, permission fact, or platform object
install and revoke receipts are validated against the exact retained command before success
renewal success is the exact payload-free acknowledgement to its one retained request
the receiver revalidates current monotonic time and runtime authority inside the serialized runtime owner
the receiver completes within four monotonic seconds and the sender waits at most five

there is no handled application-error envelope; rejection, timeout, cancellation after send, malformed traffic, unknown fields, cross-kind replies, premature traffic, and concurrent admission terminate the generation
generation loss invokes menu-runtime authority invalidation and the Agent treats every ambiguous result as Control teardown
runtime lifecycle traffic contains no media, input, screen pixels, focus, route, credential, private key, or arbitrary diagnostic text
